about_the_game:
Work out hard and get your bonus: smash things! Bonus Club adds a new game mechanic, a new open environment and 8 new workouts to your favorite fitness app.

KEY FEATURES

👊 New game mechanic: Bonus Round Reach the goal of each workout and unlock your bonus: smash stuff! Each workout from Bonus Club DLC includes 1 destructible object. A car, a vending machine, an ATM... You'll have 1 minute to destroy and get extra points for your session!

🚦 New environment: Neon An immersive scenario, full of neon lights and inspired by real-life Les Mills Live Berlin 2024. Let the nightclub energy of the event make you stronger to get through your workout sessions!

💪 8 new workouts: Keep up the hard work and enjoy your fitness moment with 8 new training sessions!

🥊Premium cosmetics: Feel the energy with neon-themed gloves and platform!
